# Paper-Agent-Skills
Evidence-aware research writing skills for AI agents. Revise a manuscript against supplied experimen
t records and references, with traceable suggestions, focused edits, and validation reports.
Includes **academic paper revision**, **rebuttal preparation**, and **presentation storyboarding**.
The host agent performs the review; bundled Python tools package the evidence and validate edits. Th
e tools require no model API key.
Available in the skills.sh directory.
## Installation
Python 3.10+ and Node.js are required for this installation path. Install all three skills into the
shared agent directory, which DSH can discover:

Each skill includes its executable tools and readable runtime. A source checkout is not required aft
er installation. Other supported agents can be selected through the skills CLI.

The same three skills also ship as a DSH plugin bundle, which registers them as a bundled skill prov
ider in the model's skill catalog:

## Usage
Open an agent session in your working directory and provide:
> Use academic-paper-writing to revise paper.tex against results.csv and references.bib. Use .paper-
agent-venv/bin/python. Complete preparation, full-text review, edit application, and checks. Save th
e run to runs/review-01 and retain unresolved evidence gaps.
Read the outputs in `runs/review-01/results/`:

- `suggestions.md` — recommendations and unresolved items.
- `revised.md` or `revised.tex` — the rev

ised manuscript.
- `changes.diff` — the exact edits.
- `checks.md` — mechanical checks and evidence

ipt.
- `changes.diff` — the exact edits.
- `checks.md` — mechanical checks and evidence limitations.
Inputs: Markdown, single-file TeX, or text-based PDF; experiment records in JSON/CSV; references in
BibTeX/JSON. See input formats.
